tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: production-ready character sprite sheet, not a poster. Create ONE large square transparent RGBA sheet with a strict 3 by 3 grid of NINE full-body poses of the SAME lightly anthropomorphic quokka in the reference. Use the highest native resolution available, aiming at 3072x3072 or at least 2048x2048. Image 1 is the exact adopted character identity, palette, eye design, proportions, warm brown contours and subtle watercolor paper texture. Redraw fresh from that identity; do not change the character or introduce props, clothing, text, labels, borders, floor shadows, background, extra characters or decorative sparkles. Each cell has exactly one complete quokka with generous clear transparent padding, separated from neighbors. All nine share the SAME head size, torso size, tail design and natural standing body scale; do NOT enlarge bent poses. Stand feet on the same relative ground baseline except the two small hopping poses, which keep body scale. The quokka remains short upright two-legged, with small arm-like forepaws, never a natural quadruped. Keep exactly two arms, two legs, one tail, two ears; preserve the white eye surround and dark brown pupils exactly when eyes are open. Calm friendly learning-video performance, no grotesque mouth or extra fingers. Reading order fixed, left-to-right then top-to-bottom: 1 BLINK: same resting upright stance as reference, both eyelids gently fully closed, mouth small pleasant smile. 2 GREET: right forepaw gently raised in a friendly wave, both feet grounded. 3 PRESENT LEFT: gesture with a connected leftward-extending forearm toward the viewer's LEFT, gaze that way, both feet grounded. 4 PRESENT RIGHT: matching explanatory open-paw gesture toward viewer's RIGHT, gaze that way, both feet grounded. 5 THINK: one forepaw resting against chin, curious thoughtful expression and subtle head tilt. 6 AHA: pleasant small discovery reaction, eyes open, one forepaw slightly lifted; no lightbulb or effect. 7 CHEER: joyful grounded little celebration with both arms comfortably lifted, eyes smiling; maintain body and clear connected shoulders. 8 SPECIES A: soft pre-hop crouch, knees bent, forepaws naturally close to chest, feet still grounded. 9 SPECIES B: gentle little quokka hop with tucked feet, same face, torso and head scale as all other cells, tail and limbs intact; leave ample transparent margin above and below. Paint cleanly and consistently without smears, irregular pigment blotches, jagged halos, double limbs or ragged stray marks. This is the minimum reusable image key-pose set for YouTube educational videos. No need to redraw an extra neutral pose.
